snippet.title: Rip It! Card Collector | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover our new single-player card-collecting adventure where every pack brings you closer to completing your binder: Rip it! Card Collector!  

Wishlist Rip it! Card Collector: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5088440/Rip_It_Card_Collector/
 
Team Ballistic welcomes you as its newest recruit to get to know all CritKin creatures by completing the ultimate card collection! Rip packs, sell duplicates, and upgrade your equipment to collect all 1809 cards. Play at your own pace while cracking boosters to find those last missing cards... It's just you, your binder, and a whole lot of special cards!

 ___

Rip it! Card Collector is made by Cybernetic Walrus, the indie game development studio behind Roadside Research. 

Follow Cybernetic Walrus: 

Website: https://www.cyberneticwalrus.com/
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/cyberneticwalrus.bsky.social
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CyberneticWalrus/

Join the official Cybernetic Walrus Games Discord: https://discord.gg/85wuW5JEk9
